trial.skyabyss.cell.S01.desc: Climb the bone with updrafts and gliding rings.
trial.skyabyss.cell.S05.desc: Route lightning with wires and levers to the door pillar.
trial.skyabyss.cell.E01.desc: Scatter ash to make a cooled crust path over lava.
trial.skyabyss.cell.E05.desc: Forge the fire key at the great furnace.
trial.skyabyss.cell.E09.desc: Tend the hearth fire and keep it burning.

objective.skyabyss.route_carrying: Soon you are carried on to %s
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.WR1.1: The orb is faintly warm. A remnant of some light this whale swallowed long ago?
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.WR1.2: The people of the back must have carried these too, keeping time with a beat deeper than the whale's own.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.WR2.1: The bones are ringing, though there is no wind.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.WR2.2: The beat comes from far below my feet. Is the whale only keeping it for someone?
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.WR3.1: The core is pulsing. Is this what the sentries guarded?
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.WR3.2: Beside the core is a hollow where something was laid away. Were the sentries waiting for someone to come for it?
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.WR4.1: Only fluid rises through a body that does not breathe.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.WR4.2: The bone steps were laid by hand. The people of the back climbed here too.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.WR5.1: A floor of bones is searching for a single shape.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.WR5.2: The whale remembers how its bones were laid. But the beat that rings them comes up from deep underground.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.WR6.1: The edge of the ring is turning red. Maybe it is not the floor that is shrinking, but the beat.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.WR6.2: What did the sentries guard to the end, inside this narrowing ring?
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.TR1.1: Inside the pearl, a light pulses slowly.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.TR1.2: Did they gather them here instead of giving them back to the tide?
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.TR2.1: The shells sound like the tide coming in and going out.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.TR2.2: The pull of the moon reaches all the way inside the shell.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.TR3.1: The people of the back are gone, yet something still guards this place.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.TR3.2: Someone planted these saplings and left them behind.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.TR4.1: The coral branches reach out and draw back, as if making way for someone.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.TR4.2: Perhaps it was not the tide people who made this road, but the coral itself.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.TR5.1: The face of the pearl gives back a faint light.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.TR5.2: Is the moon the one the stored light goes back to? A tide can be tamed. The moon cannot.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.TR6.1: The moons on the wall wax, wane, and wax again.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.TR6.2: The further along the wall, the larger the moons are carved, as if someone were counting the moon coming closer.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.TR7.1: The brood mother keeps what look like shadows of herself.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.TR7.2: Only what is left at the feet tells the real from the false. And from far beneath those feet, a beat pushes up.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.SR1.1: The feather is light. Wind runs through the bones.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.SR1.2: The wind in the bones seemed to call my name. I have never been here before. Have I?
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.SR2.1: Copper lines pass the lightning from pillar to pillar.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.SR2.2: At the foot of the pillar, tally marks are bundled in fours, as if someone kept coming back and counting.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.SR3.1: Lightning falls from the sky. Yet the beat under my feet rises from below.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.SR3.2: Wrapped in its storm, what is the bird hiding from? ...The shadow above?
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.ER1.1: The ember cools even as you hold it.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.ER1.2: The ember's heat rises from beneath the mountain. Cooled blood crumbles. This mountain too, someday.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.ER2.1: The smith in the mural is hammering something small.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.ER2.2: Was the key forged at a furnace like this? If the key was once one, perhaps the four beats were too.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.ER3.1: When the furnace fire thins, the floor sinks a little.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.ER3.2: When the fire dies, the titan sleeps and sinks. Something is waiting down there. I can feel it.
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.inscription_raid_: On the wall of the resting place at the entrance to the chain road. Those who dropped the bridge behind them seem never to have looked back.
Carved at the entrance to the valve room. It seems the forge ran on four breaths.

At the entrance to the pupils' hall, on the wall of the resting place. This one stone alone has been recut again and again.

Every morning the pupils must have walked past these words on their way to the forge.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.ER4.1: The chains holding this bridge are still bright. Someone crossed here not long ago.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.ER4.2: You only cut the road behind you when something is chasing you. Were they running from the fire that climbs up from below?
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.ER5.1: The valve wheels are worn smooth where hands turned them, again and again.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.ER5.2: Four breaths made into one. Were the four titans' beats once a single breath as well?
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.ER6.1: Four lamps on the wall. Is that how many pupils were taught here? Maybe the smith was one of them.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.ER6.2: Every pupil stands with the same master's habits. The more you cut down, the closer the master's face comes.
